description: This file defines a PHP class 'SugarWidgetSubPanelLoadSignedButton' that extends 'SugarWidgetField'. The class includes methods to render a header cell and a list cell in a subpanel, specifically for loading signed documents in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. The displayList method constructs a URL with relevant record and module information, and conditionally generates an HTML link with an icon for loading signed documents, based on the contract status and template status.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelLoadSignedButton
classes.description: A widget class used in subpanels for providing a button/link to load signed documents related to contracts.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns an empty space for the header cell in the subpanel.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates an HTML link with an icon to load a signed document, based on the current layout data and application strings. It constructs a URL with relevant identifiers and checks contract status to determine if the link should be displayed.
